title: Render a deck to slides and a PDF
description: Renders a saved draft (id), a deck JSON file (deckPath) or an inline deck to PNG slides and carousel.pdf, and runs the layout check. Optional size (portrait, square, story) and outDir (inside the data dir). Needs a local Chrome, Chromium or Edge. Never publishes.
phrases: make the pngs for this carousel

safety.rule: Writes local files only. Never publishes.
safety.notes: Runs a headless browser on this machine. No network calls of its own.
